name: open-models-cpu
_comment: Open-weight Qwen2.5-Coder size ladder (Apache-2.0), Q4_K_M GGUF, served by llama.cpp llama-server on a 2-vCPU CPU-only workspace. No API key. One task per difficulty level to keep the CPU run to about two hours; the same five tasks for every model.

models.label: Qwen2.5-Coder 0.5B
models.inference_provider: llama.cpp llama-server (built from the llama-cpp-python 0.3.35 vendored source), CPU, Q4_K_M

infrastructure.rate_source: Reference rate: AWS EC2 c7i.large (2 vCPU, 4 GiB) Linux on-demand us-east-1 $0.0892/h, https://www.doit.com/compute/compute/aws/us-east-1/c7i.large, retrieved 2026-10-01. Comparable, not identical, hardware.
